name: Interaction Layer
plainEnglish: How users, agents, APIs, files, tools, and external systems communicate with the agent ecosystem.
businessPurpose: This is the front door and communication fabric of an agentic system.

name: Runtime Layer
plainEnglish: Where agents reason, plan, remember, call tools, execute workflows, and perform work.
businessPurpose: This is where AI-driven work and operational decisions happen.

name: TrustOps Layer
plainEnglish: The governance, monitoring, approval, identity, policy, and accountability layer for trusted autonomy.
businessPurpose: This is the seatbelt, dashboard, brakes, and audit evidence for agentic systems.
